description: Set a human reference value (anchor) for a workflow (ablauf, e.g. laborder|bericht|offerte — or a function type for the software level) and comparison (vergleich hand|klassische_software): minuten_hand, minuten_kontrolle, minuten_klassisch, or for the software level personentage and wartung_chf_jahr; notiz. Appended with person and timestamp; the latest per ablauf/vergleich wins and is given to the Analyse-Agent as an anchor for future estimates. Admins and planners (humans) only.

ablauf.description: Workflow (e.g. laborder, bericht, offerte) or function type for the software level

minuten_hand.description: Reference minutes for doing the work by hand

minuten_kontrolle.description: Reference minutes for checking the AI result

vergleich.description: Comparison the reference value applies to

wartung_chf_jahr.description: Software level: maintenance cost in CHF per year

name: set_ersparnis_richtwert
